subject: Finalize MAP & paperwork timeline — Holton Retail POC
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Holt <kevin.holt@holtonretail.com>, Procurement Team <procurements@holtonretail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & paperwork timeline — Holton Retail POC

Kevin / Team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is the working Mutual Action Plan (MAP_Holton_v3.pdf) and a short evaluation plan that maps test cases to week-by-week milestones (EvalPlan_Holton.xlsx). High level proposal:

- Week 0 (signing): SOW + basic onboarding (account provisioning, API keys, test dataset access)
- Week 1: Integration sprint — sample inference flows, latency checks, basic quality smoke tests
- Week 2: Targeted evals (checkout flows, personalization prompts) and joint tuning
- Week 3: Final validation & go/no-go decision point; production toggle readiness

Critical asks from your side:
1) Procurement to confirm signatory and ETA for SOW execution (we can support DocuSign).
2) Security to confirm that SOC2 summary is sufficient or list specific evidence required.
3) Product/Eng to agree on three representative prompt sets for the week-2 eval.

We propose a target start date (customer-visible) of Monday, 06 Jul 2026 if paperwork completes by end of next week (Fri, 26 Jun). If procurement needs more time, please flag ASAP so we can slide dates and re-sequence the evals.

Attached: MAP_Holton_v3.pdf, EvalPlan_Holton.xlsx, SOW_Holton_draft.docx, Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf

Cheers,
Hannah
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0192

From: Kevin Holt <kevin.holt@holtonretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurements@holtonretail.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & paperwork timeline — Holton Retail POC

Hannah —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the detailed MAP. A couple of clarifications from procurement / legal perspective:

- Our procurement lead (cc-ed) needs the SOW to show the expected start date and the billing cadence clearly — can you push a SOW that has a fixed start date placeholder and an option for a delayed start?
- We will likely need a 7–10 business day review for any standard contract with redlines. Elena (our external counsel) is looped in and will coordinate on redline turnaround.
- For SOC2, our security team will review the summary; if they request more, Elena will request the audit letter.

From a timeline standpoint, we are aiming to complete reviews by 26 Jun but it may slip depending on legal. We like the Week 2 eval plan — I'll confirm the representative prompt sets by end of tomorrow.

Kevin
Head of AI Platforms — Holton Retail
kevin.holt@holtonretail.com | +1-646-555-0222

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & paperwork timeline — Holton Retail POC

Hannah / Monica —

Quick internal notes after reading the MAP and EvalPlan:
- Ops: we can provision the test cluster by 29 Jun if SOW is signed and we have the final list of endpoints.
- Runtime: recommend enabling prefix KV caching for the shopping-cart flows to avoid inflation of token costs during eval (Config note in the eval doc).
- Legal / Billing: Monica — please prepare two SOW variants: (A) start date 06 Jul and (B) start date TBD with a billing-on-activation clause.

I'll draft the technical checklist to attach to the final MAP and ping infra to reserve capacity.

- Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Holt <kevin.holt@holtonretail.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurements@holtonretail.com>
Cc: Elena Meyer <elena.meyer@ssc-legal.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: SOW variants and signature options — Holton Retail

Kevin / Team —

Attached are two SOW drafts as Vivek suggested: SOW_Holton_draft_A.docx (start 06 Jul) and SOW_Holton_draft_B.docx (billing-on-activation). A couple of notes:

- We can run DocuSign and nominate an internal Redwood counter-signatory to speed execution. If Holton prefers Elena to propose redlines first, we can do a staged DocuSign (accept then amend).
- For procurement efficiency: if you confirm the signatory name + email, I can set up a preparatory DocuSign envelope that includes the MAP as an annex.
- If legal requests changes that affect pricing/SLAs, flag immediately so we can get a quick exec review.

Proposed decision window for you: please pick A or B by Fri, 26 Jun EOD so we can hit provisioning targets. If you need a formal approval from procurement committee, tell us the committee meeting date and we will align our timelines.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Contracts — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_Holton_draft_A.docx; SOW_Holton_draft_B.docx

From: Kevin Holt <kevin.holt@holtonretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurements@holtonretail.com>, Elena Meyer <elena.meyer@ssc-legal.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOW variants and signature options — Holton Retail

Monica / Hannah / Team —

We reviewed both SOW options with procurement and legal. Decision: we will proceed with variant B (billing-on-activation) to preserve our internal approval window.

Action items we agree to:
1) Holton will return an executed DocuSign envelope for SOW_B by Wed, 30 Jun.
2) Redwood will provision the test cluster by Tue, 06 Jul if SOW_B is executed by the 30th.
3) Week-2 eval prompt set confirmation: Kevin to send three representative prompt files by Mon, 29 Jun.
4) Legal (Elena) will send any final redlines by Mon, 29 Jun — we ask Redwood to confirm whether those impact start date or pricing.

If we hit these dates, Holton plans to make the formal go/no-go decision on Thu, 16 Jul (end of Week 3) and, assuming go, target soft launch the following week.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Kevin Holt
Head of AI Platforms — Holton Retail
